description_expanded: ABOUT 224 WINSTON: Welcome to this exquisite beachfront property boasting stunning views of the Emerald Coast and offering access to a community pool. This spacious property accommodates up to 17 guests, featuring 5 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, 2 half bathrooms, and 2 office spaces - an ideal setting for family gatherings, friend getaways, and remote work retreats. Situated on the East end of 30A, the property is just a short stroll from the vibrant downtown area of Rosemary Beach, with its charming open markets, boutique shops, and diverse dining options. Upon entering the home, the first floor presents two inviting bedrooms: a Master King Ensuite with a private outdoor patio and a Queen Ensuite. The first-floor deck offers breathtaking views, comfortable seating, and a fire pit, providing a perfect setting for relaxation and socializing. Moving to the second floor, you'll discover a well-appointed open kitchen and living space that opens up to a balcony with captivating Gulf views. This level also features an office space and a bunk room equipped with a 3-story Queen Bunk and a 3-story Twin Bunk, along with a full bathroom. Furthermore, the third floor offers a Full bed and crib ideal for families with young children. The King Master Ensuite on this floor boasts a charming sitting area, a private balcony, and unparalleled Gulf vistas. Treat your loved ones to a memorable vacation experience at 224 Winston Lane, where you can unwind after a day at the beach, pool, or exploring the enchanting surroundings of 30A on the 4 complimentary cruiser bikes provided. Cap off your days with a beverage of your choice and savor world-class sunsets from the comfort of your private balconies. ABOUT THE AREA: Inlet Beach is a charming beach neighborhood located along Florida's scenic Highway 30A. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, and relaxed atmosphere, Inlet Beach offers a peaceful coastal getaway for visitors seeking a more laid-back vacation experience. This quaint community is characterized by its quiet residential streets lined with beautiful beach cottages and upscale vacation homes, perfect for those looking to unwind and enjoy the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. Inlet Beach provides easy access to a variety of outdoor activities, including swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing. The nearby Camp Helen State Park offers nature trails for hiking and birdwatching, while Lake Powell - one of Florida's largest coastal dune lakes - provides opportunities for boating and wildlife viewing. Visitors can also explore the neighboring beach communities of Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Aly's Beach, each offering unique shopping, dining, and entertainment options. With its pristine beaches, serene ambiance, and proximity to a wealth of recreational opportunities, Inlet Beach is a hidden gem along Highway 30A, perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Private Beach PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Private Beach * 4 bikes included * 6 beach towels * Newly updated * Short walk to the beach * 4 Chairs and 2 umbrellas are included. This is seasonal from March 1-October31. PARKING: * Free Parking up to 3 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older * Additional $1000.00 refundable security deposit charged at confirmation DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle, with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties, and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.
